question: What kind of relationship will Felt and Beako end up with? It seemed like they were getting along reasonably well in the fight against gluttony in the web novel.
answer: If they have lots of chances to meet they might become good friends, but perhaps it depends on how they come in contact. Subaru wants to make sure that Beako has lots of friends, so if he happened to see the two of them getting along well, I think he'd think of schemes to try and make them friends.
